decision: I moved the shared save, read-back and send steps into one private helper, `sendReport`. Each exported function now renders its HTML and calls the helper. I kept the read-back of the saved copy because mira-app ADR 0024 requires emails to be built from the stored copy, so removing it would break that decision. Exports, arguments and return values are unchanged. `npm test` has no tests to run, so I only checked that the file parses with `node --check`.

recorded.info: Added a private `sendReport(shop, kind, key, html, subject)` helper that saves the report, reads it back from the store, mails it and returns `{shopId, kind, bytes}`. `sendDailyReport`, `sendWeeklyReport` and `sendCorrection` are now short wrappers that render and call the helper; they stay async with the same exports and return values.
